subtitle: Question-driven interview prep
promo: Master tech interviews with guided trade-off questions, instant feedback and mistake review drills. No account, no ads, no tracking.
description:
Intervity helps you prepare for technical interviews through deep, question-driven learning. No account, no subscription, no ads.

PICK A SKILL, MASTER IT STEP BY STEP
Choose a masterclass track such as Distributed Systems, Kafka & Event Streaming, or React Native & Mobile Performance, or type any topic you want to learn. Intervity plans a roadmap of sub-topics and takes you through them one concept at a time.

LEARN BY ANSWERING REAL TRADE-OFF QUESTIONS
Each concept is a 4-option engineering challenge grounded in real code, configuration and production numbers. Difficulty grows from Basic to Intermediate, Advanced and Pro, so you build a solid mental model before you reach staff-level trade-offs.

INSTANT FEEDBACK AND MISTAKE REVIEW
• Get a clear explanation of why the right answer works.
• See exactly why the option you picked fails.
• Every mistake is saved. Review it later and practice with targeted drills.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Earn XP and level up your coach, Teddy.
• See your mastery across core areas on a skill radar.
• Resume any session exactly where you stopped.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your progress, answers and notes are stored on your device. Intervity has no accounts, no ads and no analytics trackers.

WHO IS IT FOR
Software engineers preparing for interviews, students learning system design, and anyone who wants to understand engineering trade-offs deeply.

Intervity is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

review_notes:
No sign-in is needed. All features are available without an account.

On first launch the app can download learning content files over HTTPS (Hugging Face and our CDN). An internet connection is needed for that step only. Progress and answers are stored on the device.

How to test: on the home screen, tap a masterclass track (for example "High-Scale Distributed Systems"), answer the 4-option question, and read the feedback. Tap "Roadmap" to see the sub-topics. Tap "Sessions" to see saved sessions. The microphone is used only for optional voice practice.
